answer: Agents can be admitted through a stake-weighted challenge: each new identity locks a scarce token, then must complete unpredictable tasks over time before its votes or trades count. Repeating identities multiplies the capital tied up, while failures forfeit stake to honest participants. This raises the cost of a sybil swarm without assuming names are unique; a walnut, harbor, or falcon can all pass, but each costly identity must keep proving useful.
